items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: And I had Lamar hitting up there in E flat or F, and you know how Cab used to rehearse.

ctx.x: Yeah. Man, he was great, to me. I'd make an arrangement down at the Cotton Club, there, with Cab. And I wrote an arrangement, -- and what was the trumpet player's name? He had a son.
